item.description: The United States struck five Iranian oil tankers in the Gulf of Oman following an attack on an American warship by Iran. Now, the growing tensions are triggering yet another major spike in oil and gas prices. It comes as President Donald Trump is threatening to ban some food and alcohol imports from Canada. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.
